SELECT 1 AS one FROM (SELECT `email_infos`.* FROM `email_infos` ORDER BY `email_infos`.`id` DESC LIMIT 1000) email_infos WHERE (email_infos.sent_at >= '2026-10-28 11:30:45.123000') LIMIT 1

SELECT 1 AS one FROM `email_infos` WHERE `email_infos`.`type` = 'CustomerEmailInfo' AND `email_infos`.`email_name` = 'receipt' AND `email_infos`.`state` IN ('sent', 'bounced') AND (email_infos.id > '2') LIMIT 1
